name: Tier-1 Bank Alumni
indicator: Founder previously held a product, engineering, or risk role at a Tier-1 bank (JPM, Deutsche, HSBC, Nordea, Barclays, BNP, SEB, DNB, etc.)
search_method: Search founder name + bank name on LinkedIn; check 'Experience' section
threshold: Named role at Tier-1 bank for ≥2 years in a relevant function
anti_signal: No financial institution background in founding team

name: Payment Network Alumni
indicator: Founder held a role at Visa, Mastercard, SWIFT, Nets, Worldline, or equivalent global payment network
search_method: Search founder LinkedIn profile; filter by company name in experience
threshold: Named role at a global payment network or scheme
anti_signal: Founding team has no payments infrastructure experience

name: Regulator / Central Bank Alumni
indicator: Founder previously worked at ECB, BaFin, FCA, Finanstilsynet, DNB, Riksbank, Finansinspektionen, or BIS
search_method: Search founder name + regulator on LinkedIn; check central bank staff publication lists
threshold: Named role at a financial regulator or central bank for ≥1 year
anti_signal: No regulatory experience anywhere in founding team

name: DeFi / Crypto Protocol Core Team
indicator: Founder was core team (not just user) at an established crypto protocol — Ethereum, Solana, Polkadot, Cosmos, etc.
data_source: LinkedIn, GitHub contributor lists, protocol websites
search_method: Search GitHub contributors list of major protocols; cross-reference with founder LinkedIn
threshold: Named as core contributor or founding team member at a protocol with >$1B TVL
anti_signal: Crypto experience only as investor or enthusiast

name: Big Tech / FAANG Engineering Pedigree
indicator: Founder or CTO held senior engineering role at Google, Meta, Amazon, Apple, Microsoft, or equivalent
search_method: Search founder LinkedIn; look for Google/Meta/Amazon in experience with engineer/director titles
threshold: Senior engineer, staff engineer, or engineering manager at a Big Tech firm for ≥2 years
anti_signal: No engineering pedigree at scale beyond startup

name: Successful Fintech Alumni
indicator: Founder was core team (pre-Series B hire) at a now-unicorn or exited European fintech (Klarna, Wise, N26, Revolut, Monzo, iZettle, Paysafe, Nets, etc.)
search_method: Cross-reference founder LinkedIn employment history with known European fintech unicorns
threshold: Named in a named fintech unicorn's early team (first 50 employees or pre-Series B)
anti_signal: No connection to a successful fintech company

name: PhD in Cryptography or Distributed Systems
indicator: Founder or CTO holds a PhD in cryptography, distributed computing, mathematics, or computer science from a named university
data_source: LinkedIn, university publication databases, Google Scholar
search_method: Search '[Founder name] PhD' and '[Founder name] site:scholar.google.com'
threshold: Named PhD from a top-100 university in a directly relevant field
anti_signal: No academic research background in the team

name: Published Cryptography / Fintech Research
indicator: Founder has a named paper on arXiv, SSRN, IEEE, or ACM in cryptography, digital payments, or distributed systems
search_method: Search 'site:arxiv.org [founder name]' and '[founder name] site:scholar.google.com'
threshold: At least one peer-reviewed or arXiv paper with 10+ citations
anti_signal: No research publications from any team member

name: Prior Successful Exit
indicator: Founder previously founded a company that was acquired or IPO'd (any industry)
search_method: Search '[founder name] acquired' or '[company name] acquisition' on Crunchbase and news
threshold: Named acquisition with acquirer identified, or IPO
anti_signal: No prior company founding; or prior company failed with no public outcome

name: Serial B2B SaaS Founder
indicator: Founder has previously built and scaled a B2B SaaS business to Series A or beyond
search_method: Search Crunchbase for founder profile; filter previous companies by funding stage reached
threshold: Prior company raised Series A or beyond with founder as co-founder or CEO
anti_signal: First-time founder with no B2B background

name: Prior Company Revenue Milestone Publicly Disclosed
indicator: Founder's prior company publicly disclosed reaching a revenue milestone (£1M ARR, €5M ARR, etc.)
search_method: Search '[prior company name] ARR' or '[prior company name] revenue' in news
threshold: Named ARR or revenue milestone publicly disclosed for a prior company
anti_signal: No revenue milestones ever publicly disclosed

name: Speaker at Tier-1 Industry Event
indicator: Founder appeared as a speaker (not attendee) at Sibos, Money2020, Finovate, Nordic Fintech Week, Web Summit, or Paris Fintech Forum in past 24 months
search_method: Search event websites for speaker lists; search '[founder name] + [event name]' on YouTube
threshold: Named speaker slot (not panellist or fireside only) at a named Tier-1 event
anti_signal: No conference speaking visible

name: Named in Tier-1 Financial Media
indicator: Founder quoted or profiled in FT, Bloomberg, Reuters, WSJ, or The Banker in past 12 months
search_method: Search 'site:ft.com [founder name]' or 'site:bloomberg.com [founder name]'
threshold: Direct quote or named profile in a Tier-1 outlet
anti_signal: Only self-published or company blog coverage

name: Named in Fintech Specialist Press
indicator: Founder quoted or profiled in Finextra, The Block, Coindesk, Payments Dive, or Sifted in past 12 months
search_method: Search '[founder name] site:finextra.com' and '[founder name] site:sifted.eu'
threshold: Direct quote or named profile in specialist press
anti_signal: No coverage in fintech specialist media

name: Named on Fintech 'Ones to Watch' List
indicator: Founder named on Forbes 30u30, FT125, Sifted Rising Stars, or equivalent in any year
search_method: Search '[founder name] Forbes' or '[founder name] Sifted rising'
threshold: Named on any credible industry list
anti_signal: No recognition from any credible third party

name: Regulatory Consultation Contributor
indicator: Founder or company named as a contributor to an ESMA, EBA, ECB, or national regulator consultation response
data_source: EUR-Lex, regulator websites, ESMA consultation register
search_method: Search '[company name] site:eba.europa.eu' and '[company name] site:esma.europa.eu'
threshold: Named submission in a public regulatory consultation document
anti_signal: No visible regulatory engagement beyond compliance

name: Named CCO / MLRO with Regulator Background
indicator: Company has a named Chief Compliance Officer or MLRO whose LinkedIn shows prior experience at a regulator or ACAMS/ICA qualification
search_method: Search company LinkedIn page → People → filter by 'Compliance'; check individual profiles
threshold: Named CCO/MLRO with ≥3 years at a regulator or Tier-1 bank compliance function
anti_signal: No dedicated compliance lead identifiable

name: Named GC / Legal Counsel with Financial Regulation Specialism
indicator: Company has an in-house General Counsel or Legal Director with prior experience at a financial regulation law firm (Linklaters, Clifford Chance, Allen & Overy, etc.)
search_method: Search company → People → filter 'Legal'; check for named law firm experience in profiles
threshold: Named GC with ≥3 years at a financial regulation law firm or regulator legal team
anti_signal: No in-house legal; only external counsel visible

name: Head of Partnerships from Payment Network or Tier-1 Bank
indicator: Company's BD/Partnerships leader previously worked in partnerships at Visa, Mastercard, SWIFT, or a Tier-1 bank
search_method: Search company → People → filter 'Business Development' or 'Partnerships'
threshold: Named Head of Partnerships with prior payment network or Tier-1 bank partnership role
anti_signal: No dedicated partnerships function or lead

name: Engineering Team >10 with ≥30% Fintech Background
indicator: Company LinkedIn shows engineering headcount >10 with a significant proportion having prior fintech or bank tech experience
data_source: LinkedIn company page → People filter → Engineering
search_method: Search company LinkedIn people tab, filter by Engineering, review profiles for prior employer
threshold: ≥10 engineers; ≥3 with named fintech/bank prior employer
anti_signal: Single-digit engineering team or no fintech engineering pedigree

name: Advisor from Tier-1 Bank C-Suite or Central Bank
indicator: Named advisor (with equity, not honorary) is a current or former C-suite at a Tier-1 bank or central bank
search_method: Review company website advisor section; search advisor names on LinkedIn for current/prior roles
threshold: Named advisor with verifiable C-suite role at a Tier-1 institution
anti_signal: No named advisors, or advisors have no financial services background

name: Advisor with Wikipedia Page or Major Financial Services Profile
indicator: Named advisor has a Wikipedia page or is listed in a major financial services directory
search_method: Search '[advisor name] Wikipedia' and check institutional biography pages
threshold: Advisor with Wikipedia presence or verified named biography at a major institution
anti_signal: Advisors are unknown outside the company's own marketing

name: Active Hiring in DACH or Nordics or UK (Sales/BD)
indicator: Company has live job postings for Sales, Business Development, or Account Executive roles specifically in DACH, Nordics, or UK
data_source: LinkedIn Jobs, company careers page, Indeed
search_method: Search company LinkedIn Jobs tab; filter by location; check for DACH/Nordic/UK sales roles
threshold: ≥1 active sales/BD job posting in a named target market
anti_signal: No hiring in target markets despite claiming presence there

name: Hiring for Deep Crypto/Cryptography Engineering
indicator: Job postings include 'MPC', 'ZKP', 'zero-knowledge proofs', 'HSM', or 'cryptography' as explicit requirements
search_method: Search company careers page for these terms; also search LinkedIn jobs '[company name] cryptography'
threshold: ≥1 active posting explicitly requiring cryptographic engineering skill
anti_signal: Engineering roles are generic; no cryptographic specialism required

name: Hiring for Compliance / AML Specialist
indicator: Company has an active job posting for a named compliance, AML, MLRO, or regulatory affairs role
search_method: Search LinkedIn Jobs for company name + 'compliance' or 'AML'
threshold: Active compliance hiring, indicating investment in regulatory infrastructure
anti_signal: No compliance hiring visible (for a regulated or regulated-adjacent company)

name: SWIFT / ISO 20022 Cited in Job Requirements
indicator: Job postings explicitly require SWIFT, ISO 20022, or SEPA knowledge as a technical skill
search_method: Search '[company name] jobs SWIFT' or '[company name] jobs ISO 20022'
threshold: SWIFT or ISO 20022 cited as required skill in an engineering or product role
anti_signal: No reference to financial messaging standards in any job posting

name: Headcount Growth >50% in Past 12 Months
indicator: Company LinkedIn employee count grew by ≥50% in the past 12 months (year-over-year employee count)
search_method: Compare current LinkedIn headcount vs Wayback Machine snapshot 12 months ago, or track via Dealroom
threshold: ≥50% headcount growth year-over-year
anti_signal: Headcount flat or declining

name: Hiring in a Non-European Market (US, Singapore, UAE)
indicator: Company has active job postings in the US, Singapore, or UAE — indicating global expansion
search_method: Search LinkedIn Jobs for company name; filter by US/Singapore/UAE locations
threshold: ≥1 active job posting outside Europe in a commercial or operational role
anti_signal: All hiring confined to one European country

name: Founder LinkedIn >5,000 Followers in Fintech Audience
indicator: Founder's personal LinkedIn has >5,000 followers with a visible fintech/banking audience
search_method: Navigate to founder's LinkedIn profile; note follower count and recent post engagement
threshold: ≥5,000 followers with >50 average engagements per post
anti_signal: Founder LinkedIn has <500 followers or is dormant

name: Founder Active Publisher on LinkedIn (10+ Articles)
indicator: Founder has published ≥10 articles or newsletters on LinkedIn in the past 12 months on fintech/digital finance topics
search_method: Navigate to founder LinkedIn → Activity → Articles; count and review topics
threshold: ≥10 published pieces in past 12 months on relevant topics
anti_signal: No publishing activity; LinkedIn profile is static

name: Team Presence Across ≥3 Target Markets (DACH + Nordics + UK)
indicator: Company's LinkedIn team shows employees based in ≥3 of: Germany, Austria, Switzerland, Sweden, Norway, Denmark, Finland, UK
data_source: LinkedIn company page → People → filter by location
search_method: Click 'See all employees' on LinkedIn; filter by location
threshold: Named employees in ≥3 of the target markets (not just registered offices)
anti_signal: All team members in one country

name: Founder Invited to Testify or Present to Parliament / Regulatory Body
indicator: Founder has been invited to present to a parliamentary committee, ECON committee (EU), or named regulatory expert group
data_source: EU Parliament website, Hansard, national parliament websites
search_method: Search '[founder name] parliament' or '[founder name] committee'; check EP ECON hearings
threshold: Named appearance in a parliamentary or expert group hearing
anti_signal: No regulatory or legislative engagement visible

name: Founding Team from ≥5 Different Prior Employers
indicator: The founding team collectively has worked at ≥5 distinct financial institutions or technology companies
search_method: Review all founder LinkedIn profiles; list prior employers; count distinct institutions
threshold: ≥5 distinct employers across the founding team
anti_signal: Founding team all from the same prior employer (group-think risk)

name: Founder Co-authored Report with Named Think Tank
indicator: Founder is a named co-author on a report published by Bruegel, OMFIF, CEPS, Z/Yen, or equivalent
search_method: Search '[founder name] site:omfif.org', '[founder name] site:bruegel.org', etc.
threshold: Named co-authorship on a published think tank report
anti_signal: No policy or research engagement beyond company blogs

name: Company Named in BIS or IMF Working Paper
indicator: Company or its technology cited in a BIS, IMF, or World Bank working paper
search_method: Search 'site:bis.org [company name]' and 'site:imf.org [company name]'
threshold: Named reference in a BIS, IMF, or World Bank document
anti_signal: No reference in supranational research

name: Founder Prior Company had Named Acquirer
indicator: Founder's prior company was acquired and the acquirer is publicly named (not just 'acquired')
search_method: Search '[prior company name] acquired by' on Crunchbase and Google News
threshold: Named acquirer with disclosed deal (even if amount undisclosed)
anti_signal: No exit history or outcome unclear

name: Founder has Built a Product Used by a Financial Institution
indicator: Founder's prior work included shipping a product that a named financial institution used in production
search_method: Search '[founder name] + [bank name]' and '[prior company] case study financial'
threshold: Verifiable prior product deployment at a named financial institution
anti_signal: No prior B2B financial institution deployment

name: Named Board Member who is Former FI CEO
indicator: Company has a named board member (not advisor) who is a former CEO of a financial institution or payment company
data_source: Company website board page, LinkedIn, Companies House
search_method: Check company website board section; search each name on LinkedIn for C-suite history
threshold: Former CEO of a financial institution or payment network named on the board
anti_signal: No external board members; founders only on the board

name: CTO has Open-Source Contributions to Major Protocol
indicator: CTO has verifiable commits or pull requests to a major open-source financial or blockchain project
search_method: Search CTO's GitHub profile (if public); check contributions tab for named major repos
threshold: ≥10 merged pull requests to a repo with >1,000 stars
anti_signal: CTO has no public GitHub profile or no open-source contribution history

name: Founder Active Participant in Standards Body
indicator: Founder is a named participant in W3C, IETF, ISO TC68, or ISO TC307 working group related to digital finance
search_method: Search W3C community group lists; IETF datatracker contributor list; ISO committee members
threshold: Named participant in a standards working group with at least one contribution
anti_signal: No standards body engagement visible

name: Active GitHub Organisation with Multiple Repos
indicator: Company has a public GitHub organisation with ≥5 repositories and commits in the past 30 days
search_method: Navigate to github.com/[company-name]; count repos; check most recent commit dates
threshold: ≥5 repos, at least 1 commit in past 30 days
anti_signal: No public GitHub presence, or abandoned repos (last commit >6 months ago)

name: Primary Repo has ≥200 Stars
indicator: Company's primary code repository has ≥200 GitHub stars from external users
search_method: Navigate to company's primary repo; check star count
threshold: ≥200 stars, indicating community adoption or recognition
anti_signal: <50 stars; may indicate limited external interest

name: External Contributors to GitHub Repos
indicator: Company's repositories have ≥10 named contributors who are not company employees
search_method: Click 'Contributors' on primary repos; cross-reference contributor profiles with company LinkedIn
threshold: ≥10 external contributors with verifiable non-employee profiles
anti_signal: All contributors are company employees; no external contribution

name: Public API Documentation Site
indicator: Company has a dedicated API documentation website (docs.company.com, api.company.com, or developer portal)
search_method: Search '[company name] API docs' or '[company name] developer portal'; navigate to docs subdomain
threshold: Structured API reference with endpoints, authentication, and examples
anti_signal: No public developer documentation; API only available after sales NDA

name: ISO 20022 Referenced in Technical Docs
indicator: Company's technical documentation or API reference explicitly mentions ISO 20022 message types
search_method: Search company docs site for 'ISO 20022' or 'pain.001' or 'pacs.008'
threshold: Explicit ISO 20022 message type references in API or technical docs
anti_signal: No reference to financial messaging standards in any technical documentation

name: W3C DID or Verifiable Credentials Referenced
indicator: Company documentation references W3C Decentralised Identifiers (DID) or Verifiable Credentials (VC) standards
search_method: Search company docs for 'DID', 'Verifiable Credential', 'W3C DID'; check GitHub for relevant libraries
threshold: Explicit W3C DID or VC standard references in technical documentation
anti_signal: No reference to digital identity standards; proprietary identity approach only

name: FIDO2 / WebAuthn Referenced in Product or Docs
indicator: Company references FIDO2 or WebAuthn authentication standards (especially relevant for eID companies)
search_method: Search company website and docs for 'FIDO2', 'WebAuthn', 'passkey'
threshold: FIDO2 or WebAuthn cited as supported authentication standard
anti_signal: No reference to open authentication standards

name: Third-Party Security Audit Published
indicator: Company has published a security audit report from a named third-party firm (Certik, Trail of Bits, Halborn, Cure53, NCC Group, etc.)
search_method: Search company website for 'audit report'; check GitHub for audit documents; search '[company] security audit'
threshold: Named audit firm; published report (even if partially redacted)
anti_signal: No security audit; only internal self-assessment mentioned

name: Active Bug Bounty Programme
indicator: Company has an active bug bounty programme on HackerOne, Bugcrowd, or Intigriti
search_method: Search '[company name] site:hackerone.com' and '[company name] site:bugcrowd.com'
threshold: Active programme with named scope and rewards
anti_signal: No bug bounty programme; security reporting only via email or contact form

name: SOC 2 Type II or ISO 27001 Certification
indicator: Company holds a SOC 2 Type II or ISO 27001 information security certification
data_source: Company website trust page, BSI/UKAS/DAkkS certification databases
search_method: Search company website for 'SOC 2' or 'ISO 27001'; check BSI online certificate database
threshold: Current (not expired) certification from a named accredited body
anti_signal: No information security certification mentioned; or only claimed without a certificate number

name: HSM or MPC Key Management Referenced
indicator: Company technical documentation or job postings reference Hardware Security Modules (HSM) or Multi-Party Computation (MPC) for key management
search_method: Search company website for 'HSM', 'MPC', 'multi-party computation'; search jobs for same terms
threshold: Explicit reference to HSM or MPC key management in technical context
anti_signal: Key management not mentioned; or use of basic software wallets implied

name: Zero-Knowledge Proofs Used in Architecture
indicator: Company explicitly uses or is building with ZKPs (zk-SNARKs, zk-STARKs, Plonk, etc.)
search_method: Search company blog and GitHub for 'zero-knowledge', 'zk-SNARK', 'zkp'; check job postings
threshold: ZKP referenced in a technical context with a named proof system
anti_signal: No reference to ZKP technology

name: Listed on AWS, Azure, or GCP Marketplace
indicator: Company product is available on a major cloud provider's marketplace
data_source: AWS Marketplace, Azure Marketplace, GCP Marketplace
search_method: Search '[company name]' on each marketplace
threshold: Active listing on at least one major cloud marketplace with reviews
anti_signal: Not listed on any cloud marketplace; distribution is direct-only

name: Public Status Page Live
indicator: Company maintains a public uptime/status page (status.company.com or equivalent)
search_method: Navigate to status.[company domain]; search '[company name] status page'
threshold: Active status page updated within 30 days
anti_signal: No public status page; reliability transparency absent

name: Core Banking System Integration Announced
indicator: Company has a named, publicly announced integration with a core banking system (Thought Machine, Mambu, Temenos, Finastra, Sopra Banking, etc.)
search_method: Search '[company name] Mambu', '[company name] Temenos', etc. on Google News
threshold: Named integration with a Tier-1 core banking vendor visible in press or partner pages
anti_signal: No reference to core banking integrations

name: FAPI Certification or Financial-Grade API Standard Adopted
indicator: Company has achieved OpenID Foundation FAPI certification or explicitly implements FAPI in their API design
data_source: OpenID Foundation FAPI certified list, company docs
search_method: Search OpenID Foundation certification list at openid.net/certification; search company docs for 'FAPI'
threshold: Named in OpenID Foundation FAPI certified implementations list
anti_signal: No FAPI reference; generic REST API without financial-grade security controls

name: Sandbox / Test Environment Publicly Available
indicator: Company offers a free sandbox or developer test environment accessible without a sales call
search_method: Navigate to company developer docs; look for sandbox signup, test credentials, or Postman collection
threshold: Free sandbox accessible without a sales conversation
anti_signal: Demo only via sales call; no self-serve developer access

name: Monthly Product Releases or Changelog
indicator: Company publishes a public changelog or release notes with ≥1 release per month
data_source: Company website changelog, GitHub releases tab
search_method: Navigate to company changelog or GitHub releases; count release frequency over past 6 months
threshold: ≥1 named release per month for the past 6 months
anti_signal: No public changelog; last release note >3 months ago

name: Technical Engineering Blog with Recent Posts
indicator: Company publishes a technical engineering blog (not marketing) with posts in the past 90 days
search_method: Search '[company name] engineering blog'; check Medium or Substack for company publications
threshold: ≥2 technical posts in past 90 days covering architecture, security, or standards
anti_signal: No technical blog; only product marketing content

name: Engineering Blog Post Reached Hacker News Front Page
indicator: Company's technical content was featured on Hacker News (verifiable via search)
search_method: Search 'site:news.ycombinator.com [company name]' or use hn.algolia.com
threshold: Named appearance on Hacker News with ≥100 points
anti_signal: No Hacker News presence; technical content has no external traction

name: Patent Application Filed
indicator: Company has filed one or more patents (utility, method, or system patents) visible on patent databases
search_method: Search 'site:patents.google.com [company name]' and EPO Espacenet for applicant name
threshold: ≥1 patent application filed (grant not required)
anti_signal: No patent filings; full reliance on trade secrets or open source

name: Cited in a W3C or IETF Standards Document
indicator: Company or its technology is cited as a reference implementation or case study in a W3C or IETF RFC/draft
search_method: Search 'site:w3.org [company name]' and 'site:datatracker.ietf.org [company name]'
threshold: Named citation in a W3C note, community group output, or IETF RFC/draft
anti_signal: No standards body citation

name: Open-Sourced a Core Component
indicator: Company has open-sourced a non-trivial component of their core technology (not just SDKs or demos)
search_method: Check company GitHub for repos marked as core library; read company announcements about open-sourcing
threshold: Named open-source component released with documented purpose and community adoption
anti_signal: All code is closed source; only SDK wrappers available

name: Formal Verification Used in Smart Contracts or Protocol
indicator: Company uses formal verification tools (Certora, Coq, TLA+, Lean) for smart contracts or protocol specification
search_method: Search GitHub for company repos using Certora, TLA+; search job postings for 'formal verification'
threshold: Evidence of formal verification in audit reports or GitHub
anti_signal: No mention of formal verification; standard unit testing only

name: Named Integration with SWIFT or SEPA Connectivity
indicator: Company has a live, publicly announced integration with SWIFT (gpi, MT/MX) or direct SEPA connectivity
search_method: Search SWIFT partner directory; search '[company name] SWIFT integration' on Google
threshold: Named SWIFT or SEPA integration with go-live date
anti_signal: No reference to SWIFT or SEPA connectivity

name: Berlin Group / NextGenPSD2 Compliant API
indicator: Company's open banking API conforms to Berlin Group NextGenPSD2 standard (for EU open banking)
data_source: Berlin Group certification list, company docs
search_method: Search Berlin Group website for certified TPPs; check company docs for 'Berlin Group' or 'NextGenPSD2'
threshold: Named in Berlin Group conformance list or explicit NextGenPSD2 compliance claimed with evidence
anti_signal: No reference to open banking standards compliance

name: Named Integration with ≥3 Third Parties
indicator: Company's website or press releases show ≥3 named third-party integrations (not just 'ecosystem partners')
search_method: Navigate to company integrations or partner page; count named integrations with live links or case studies
threshold: ≥3 named integrations with go-live date or case study evidence
anti_signal: Integration page is empty or shows only logos without named case studies

name: CBDC Pilot Participant or Technology Supplier
indicator: Company has participated in or supplied technology for a CBDC pilot (mBridge, ECB digital euro, Riksbank e-krona, etc.)
search_method: Search '[company name] CBDC', '[company name] digital euro'; check BIS innovation hub project list
threshold: Named participant or technology supplier in a named CBDC project
anti_signal: No CBDC engagement; no mention of central bank digital currency projects

name: EUDIW Architecture Reference Framework Compatibility Claimed
indicator: Company product claims compatibility with the EU Digital Identity Wallet Architecture Reference Framework
data_source: Company website, GitHub, EUDIW ARF GitHub
search_method: Search company website for 'eIDAS 2.0' or 'EUDIW'; check EUDIW GitHub for contributor or reference list
threshold: Explicit ARF compatibility claim with version reference
anti_signal: No mention of eIDAS 2.0 or EUDIW in product documentation

name: Postman Collection Publicly Available
indicator: Company has published a Postman collection for their API accessible on the Postman public API network
search_method: Search Postman public API network for company name at postman.com/explore
threshold: Named collection with ≥10 requests and documentation
anti_signal: No Postman collection; API only accessible after commercial agreement

name: Developer Community (Discord/Slack/Forum) with ≥500 Members
indicator: Company has an active developer community with ≥500 named members
search_method: Search for company Discord or Slack invite links; check member count if visible
threshold: ≥500 members in an active developer community with recent activity
anti_signal: No developer community; company communication is marketing-only

name: Hackathon Win or Placement
indicator: Company has won or placed in a named technical hackathon (ETHGlobal, SWIFT Innotribe, BIS Hackathon, etc.)
data_source: Event websites, company blog, press releases
search_method: Search '[company name] hackathon'; check ETHGlobal.com for past winners
threshold: Named placement at a credible technical hackathon
anti_signal: No hackathon participation visible

name: Third-Party Developer Built on the Platform
indicator: A named third-party developer or company has publicly built a product using the company's API or SDK
data_source: Company ecosystem page, press releases, GitHub
search_method: Search '[company name] built on' or '[company name] powered by' in press; check company blog for ecosystem stories
threshold: Named third-party company or developer with a public case study built on the platform
anti_signal: No third-party builders; platform ecosystem is empty or company-only

name: Multi-Cloud or Cloud-Agnostic Architecture Referenced
indicator: Company's job postings or technical docs reference multi-cloud, Kubernetes, or Terraform — indicating infrastructure portability
search_method: Search job postings for 'Kubernetes', 'Terraform', 'multi-cloud'; check GitHub for infrastructure code
threshold: Explicit multi-cloud or infrastructure-as-code references in job requirements or public repos
anti_signal: Infrastructure locked to a single cloud provider with no portability mentioned

name: GDPR Data Architecture — Explicit Right-to-Erasure Design
indicator: Company technical docs describe how right-to-erasure (GDPR Article 17) is implemented in their architecture
data_source: Company docs, privacy policy, technical blog
search_method: Search company docs for 'right to erasure' or 'data deletion'; search technical blog for GDPR architecture posts
threshold: Documented technical approach to GDPR Article 17 compliance in their architecture
anti_signal: Privacy policy exists but no technical implementation described; or erasure not mentioned for a data-heavy product

name: Blockchain Analytics Tool Integration Disclosed
indicator: Company has publicly disclosed integration with a named blockchain analytics tool (Chainalysis, Elliptic, TRM Labs, Sardine)
data_source: Company website, partner pages, press releases
search_method: Search '[company name] Chainalysis', '[company name] Elliptic', '[company name] TRM Labs'
threshold: Named blockchain analytics integration with go-live evidence
anti_signal: No blockchain analytics tool referenced (for any company handling crypto transactions)

name: Layer 2 or ZK-Rollup Technology Referenced
indicator: Company's technical docs or job postings reference L2 networks (Optimism, Arbitrum, zkSync, Polygon zkEVM, Starknet)
search_method: Search company website and GitHub for L2 or rollup references; search job postings for L2 frameworks
threshold: Named L2 or ZK-rollup technology in a technical context with rationale
anti_signal: Naive L1-only approach with no scalability solution mentioned

name: OpenAPI / Swagger Spec Publicly Available
indicator: Company has published a machine-readable OpenAPI (Swagger) specification for their API
search_method: Search '[company name] OpenAPI' or '[company name] swagger.json'; check GitHub for openapi.yaml files
threshold: Publicly accessible OpenAPI spec with ≥20 documented endpoints
anti_signal: API undocumented or documented only in PDFs; no machine-readable spec

name: Named Integration in a Major FI's Vendor Directory
indicator: Company product appears in a Tier-1 bank's approved vendor list or technology partner announcement
data_source: Bank press releases, bank technology partner pages
search_method: Search '[bank name] [company name] partnership'; check bank innovation lab partner pages

name: EBA Innovation Hub or National CA Innovation Hub Participant
indicator: Company has engaged with the EBA Innovation Hub, BaFin Innovation Hub, DNB Innovation Lab, or equivalent

anti_signal: No sandbox or innovation hub engagement

name: EU Blockchain Regulatory Sandbox (ESMA/EBA) Participant
indicator: Company is or was a participant in the EU Blockchain Regulatory Sandbox

threshold: Named participant in the EU Blockchain Regulatory Sandbox
anti_signal: No EU regulatory sandbox engagement

name: Named MLRO on LinkedIn or Company Website
indicator: Company's Money Laundering Reporting Officer is publicly named and their LinkedIn confirms relevant qualifications
search_method: Search company website for 'MLRO'; search LinkedIn for '[company name] MLRO' or 'Money Laundering Reporting'
threshold: Named MLRO with ACAMS, ICA, or equivalent AML qualification visible
anti_signal: No MLRO named publicly; no AML compliance leadership visible

name: TRISA or OpenVASP Membership (Travel Rule)
indicator: Company is a member of the TRISA or OpenVASP Travel Rule compliance network

search_method: Navigate to TRISA member directory; search for company name
threshold: Active membership in TRISA or OpenVASP with a valid TRISA certificate
anti_signal: No Travel Rule solution in place despite handling VASP-to-VASP transfers

name: Named Blockchain Analytics Partner (Public)
indicator: Company has publicly disclosed a partnership or integration with Chainalysis, Elliptic, TRM Labs, Sardine, or Notabene

search_method: Search 'site:esma.europa.eu [company name]' and 'site:eba.europa.eu [company name]'

name: Named Participant in Industry Standards Body
indicator: Company is a named member of the European Payments Council, BIS Committee, SWIFT standards working group, or W3C financial standards group
search_method: Search EPC member list; W3C member directory; SWIFT partner directory for company name

anti_signal: No standards body membership visible

name: Digital Euro Association (DEA) Member

name: Named in a Central Bank Research Publication

name: Wolfsberg Group Questionnaire Completed

name: European Commission Expert Group Participation
indicator: Company or founder has been named as an expert in a European Commission expert group (digital finance, payments, identity)

threshold: Named expert in a European Commission expert group
anti_signal: No EC engagement beyond company's own lobbying

name: GLEIF Accredited or LEI Issuing Partner
indicator: Company is accredited by the Global Legal Entity Identifier Foundation (GLEIF) or is a named LEI issuing organisation

anti_signal: No FATF-level recognition or reference

anti_signal: Enforcement action, fine, or licence revocation visible in any jurisdiction

name: Participated in BIS Innovation Hub FinTech Programme

search_method: Count funding rounds on Crunchbase; note if rounds are labelled as 'bridge' or 'extension'
threshold: ≤3 distinct rounds pre-Series A
anti_signal: ≥4 rounds pre-Series A including multiple bridges or extensions

name: Round Announced in Sifted, TechCrunch, or EU-Startups
indicator: Fundraising announcement received independent editorial coverage (not just PR wire)
search_method: Search '[company name] funding site:sifted.eu' and '[company name] raises site:techcrunch.com'
threshold: Independent editorial coverage of funding announcement in ≥1 named outlet
anti_signal: Funding announced only via press release; no editorial coverage

name: Corporate VC Investor Has Follow-on Rights
indicator: Corporate VC investor has participated in ≥2 rounds (indicating sustained conviction, not a one-time strategic check)
search_method: Check investor participation across all funding rounds for repeat names
threshold: Same CVC named in ≥2 rounds
anti_signal: CVC invested once and did not participate in follow-on

name: Company Domain Active >2 Years
indicator: Company's website domain was registered >2 years ago (operational continuity signal)
search_method: Search '[company domain] WHOIS' on whois.domaintools.com or similar
threshold: Domain registered >24 months before assessment date
anti_signal: Domain registered <6 months ago; or domain recently transferred

name: Domain Authority >30
indicator: Company website has a Domain Authority >30 (indicating content quality and backlinks)
search_method: Search company domain on Moz Link Explorer or Ahrefs free backlink checker
threshold: Domain Authority ≥30
anti_signal: Domain Authority <15; minimal backlinks or web presence

name: Organic Website Traffic >1,000/Month
indicator: Estimated organic monthly website visits >1,000 (SimilarWeb estimate)
search_method: Search company domain on SimilarWeb; note estimated monthly visits
threshold: ≥1,000 estimated monthly visits with ≥30% organic share
anti_signal: <500 monthly visits; or >90% direct traffic suggesting no content discovery

name: LinkedIn Company Page Active (Posting ≥2x/Week)
indicator: Company LinkedIn page has published posts at least 2x per week for the past 3 months
search_method: Navigate to company LinkedIn page; check post frequency and recency over past 90 days
threshold: ≥2 posts per week for past 90 days with ≥20 average engagements
anti_signal: LinkedIn page dormant (last post >30 days ago) or never active

name: Company LinkedIn Page has ≥500 Followers
indicator: Company LinkedIn page has ≥500 followers
search_method: Check follower count on company LinkedIn page
threshold: ≥500 followers
anti_signal: <100 followers; page effectively invisible

name: Listed in European Fintech Association Member Directory
indicator: Company is a named member of a national fintech association (Fintech Germany, Innovate Finance UK, Finance Norway, FDATA, etc.)
search_method: Navigate to member directory of relevant national fintech association; search for company
threshold: Named member of ≥1 national fintech association
anti_signal: Not a member of any industry association

name: Member of European Payments Council (EPC) or Working Group
indicator: Company is a named EPC member or contributor to an EPC working group
search_method: Check EPC member list and working group participant lists
threshold: Named EPC member or working group participant
anti_signal: No EPC engagement

name: Named in SWIFT Annual Report or SWIFT Partner Ecosystem
indicator: Company referenced in SWIFT's annual report or listed in the SWIFT partner ecosystem
data_source: SWIFT annual report, SWIFT partner directory
search_method: Search SWIFT annual report PDF for company name; check SWIFT partner directory
threshold: Named in SWIFT annual report or active SWIFT partner directory listing
anti_signal: No SWIFT ecosystem reference

name: BIS Innovation Hub Named Partner or Project
indicator: Company is a named project partner in the BIS Innovation Hub
search_method: Navigate to bis.org/about/bisih/projects; search for company name
threshold: Named participant in a BIS Innovation Hub project
anti_signal: No BIS Innovation Hub engagement

name: Shortlisted or Winner at Fintech Awards (Country or EU Level)
indicator: Company was shortlisted or won an award at a national or EU-level fintech awards programme
data_source: Award programme websites, company press releases
search_method: Search '[company name] award shortlist' or '[company name] winner' combined with fintech award names
threshold: Named shortlist or winner at a credible national or EU fintech award
anti_signal: No award recognition or shortlisting

name: Company Published Original Research or Industry Report
indicator: Company has authored and published an original research report (not marketing) cited by third parties
data_source: Company website, Google Scholar, industry media
search_method: Search for company research reports; check if any are cited in external articles or reports
threshold: Original research report cited or referenced by at least one external party
anti_signal: Only marketing content published; no original research

name: Company Named in European Commission Digital Finance Strategy Document
indicator: Company or its technology cited in an EC digital finance strategy, action plan, or package
data_source: EUR-Lex, EC digital finance strategy documents
search_method: Search EUR-Lex for company name; search EC digital finance package documents (available on ec.europa.eu)
threshold: Named citation in an EC strategy or policy document
anti_signal: No EU Commission reference

name: Company or Founder Has Wikipedia Page
indicator: Company or founder has a Wikipedia page (indicating third-party notability)
search_method: Search Wikipedia for company name and founder name
threshold: Wikipedia page with verifiable, cited content
anti_signal: No Wikipedia presence

name: Company Technology Cited in Another Company's Patent
indicator: Company's technology or methodology is cited as prior art in an external patent filing
search_method: Search Google Patents for company name in citation sections
threshold: Named prior art citation in at least one external patent
anti_signal: No patent citation

name: Contributed to Position Paper with Named Policy Think Tank
indicator: Company co-authored a published position paper with Bruegel, OMFIF, CEPS, Z/Yen, or Stiftung Neue Verantwortung
search_method: Search '[company name] site:omfif.org', '[company name] site:bruegel.org', '[company name] CEPS'
threshold: Named co-authorship on a published policy paper
anti_signal: No think tank co-publication

name: Named Expert in European Parliament Committee Hearing
indicator: Company founder or executive invited to speak before ECON or LIBE committee of the European Parliament
search_method: Search EP committee hearing records for company name or founder name
threshold: Named appearance in EP committee proceedings
anti_signal: No EU Parliament engagement

name: Glassdoor Company Rating ≥4.0
indicator: Company has a Glassdoor rating ≥4.0 with ≥5 reviews
search_method: Search company name on Glassdoor; note overall rating and review count
threshold: ≥4.0 rating with ≥5 reviews
anti_signal: Rating <3.5 or fewer than 3 reviews despite being >2 years old; CEO approval <60%

name: ISO TC68 or TC307 Participant
indicator: Company is a named participant in ISO TC68 (Financial services standards) or TC307 (Blockchain standards)
search_method: Search ISO TC68 and TC307 participant lists for company name or country delegation
threshold: Named participant (observer or full member) in ISO TC68 or TC307
anti_signal: No standards body participation

name: Company's Founder Cited as Expert in Academic Paper
indicator: Founder or company cited in an academic paper (not self-authored)
search_method: Search '[founder name]' and '[company name]' on Google Scholar filtering for third-party citations
threshold: Named citation in at least one peer-reviewed or working paper by external authors
anti_signal: No academic citation

name: Company Website Available in English + ≥1 Target Market Language
indicator: Website is available in English and at least one of: German, Swedish, Norwegian, Danish, Finnish
search_method: Navigate to company website; check language selector for German/Nordic language availability
threshold: English + ≥1 DACH/Nordic language available
anti_signal: English only; no localisation for stated target markets

name: Incorporated in a Reputable EU Jurisdiction or UK
indicator: Company's primary operating entity is incorporated in: UK, Germany, Netherlands, Sweden, Denmark, Finland, Norway, Switzerland, Luxembourg, or Ireland
data_source: Companies House, Handelsregister, Bolagsverket, Brønnøysund, etc.
search_method: Search national company registries for the company name; confirm primary operating entity jurisdiction
threshold: Active incorporated entity in a named reputable jurisdiction with no adverse filings
anti_signal: Incorporated in a jurisdiction with poor regulatory transparency; complex offshore holding structure with no clear rationale

name: EU Trademark (EUTM) Filed and Active
indicator: Company has an active EU trademark for their primary brand
search_method: Search EUIPO trademark database for company name or brand
threshold: Active EUTM registration or pending application
anti_signal: No trademark; brand unprotected across EU

name: Operating Entities in ≥2 EU Member States or UK + EU
indicator: Company has incorporated legal entities in ≥2 jurisdictions (not just a registered address)
search_method: Search for the company name in German, Dutch, Swedish, and UK company registries
threshold: Active operating entities in ≥2 jurisdictions with substance (staff, office)
anti_signal: Single-entity structure in one jurisdiction; claimed multi-market presence not backed by legal entity

name: B2B Revenue Model Confirmed (No B2C)
indicator: Company's revenue comes entirely from B2B customers — no consumer-facing product
data_source: Company pricing page, terms of service, job postings
search_method: Check pricing page for enterprise-only tiers; check ToS for absence of consumer rights provisions
threshold: All pricing and product pages are enterprise/institutional; no sign-up flow for individual consumers
anti_signal: Consumer sign-up flow present; or freemium consumer tier visible

name: SaaS or Transaction Fee Revenue Model
indicator: Revenue model is recurring (SaaS subscription or volume-based transaction fees), not services or implementation
search_method: Check pricing page for recurring subscription or API usage-based fees
threshold: Documented recurring revenue model (subscription or usage-based fees)
anti_signal: Revenue primarily from implementation services or consulting; no recurring revenue component

name: TradFi + DeFi Bridge Explicit in Product Description
indicator: Company explicitly positions itself as bridging traditional finance and digital/decentralised finance
search_method: Review company 'About' page, product descriptions, and investor materials for bridge narrative
threshold: Explicit description of TradFi-DeFi bridge in product or company narrative
anti_signal: Pure TradFi product with no digital asset or DeFi element; or pure DeFi with no TradFi connectivity

name: Global Scalability Explicit in Product Architecture
indicator: Company explicitly describes their product as built for multi-jurisdiction, multi-currency global deployment
search_method: Search company website for 'global', 'multi-currency', 'multi-jurisdiction' in product context
threshold: Explicit multi-currency and multi-jurisdiction design referenced in technical or product context
anti_signal: Product designed for single currency or single market; no global design language

name: Active Hiring Outside Europe (US, Singapore, UAE, etc.)
indicator: Company has active job postings in a non-European market, signalling global expansion intent
search_method: Search LinkedIn Jobs for company name; filter by non-European locations
threshold: ≥1 active job posting outside Europe in a commercial, product, or engineering role
anti_signal: All hiring confined to one European country with no global expansion evidence

name: CBDC or EUDIW Integration on Product Roadmap
indicator: Company's public roadmap or product documentation explicitly mentions CBDC or EUDIW integration
search_method: Search company website for 'CBDC', 'digital euro', 'EUDIW', 'eIDAS 2.0' in a product roadmap context
threshold: CBDC or EUDIW integration cited in public-facing product roadmap or documentation
anti_signal: No reference to mandated digital finance infrastructure in product roadmap

name: Named as Potential Acquisition Target in Industry Analysis
indicator: Company mentioned as a potential M&A target in a named analyst or media report
data_source: Mergermarket, Dealroom M&A signals, financial media
search_method: Search '[company name] acquisition target' or '[company name] M&A' in financial media; check Mergermarket
threshold: Named in a credible analyst or media report as an acquisition candidate
anti_signal: No strategic M&A mention

name: Signed MoU with Another Financial Infrastructure Provider
indicator: Company has a signed, publicly announced MoU with a named financial infrastructure provider (core banking vendor, payment network, custodian, etc.)
search_method: Search '[company name] MoU' or '[company name] strategic partnership' on Google News
threshold: Named MoU with go-live context or joint roadmap
anti_signal: No formal partnerships; only informal relationships claimed

name: SWIFT Partner Programme or gpi Participant
indicator: Company is listed in the SWIFT Partner Programme directory or SWIFT gpi ecosystem
search_method: Navigate to SWIFT Partner Programme directory; search for company name
threshold: Active SWIFT partner listing with named contact and use case
anti_signal: No SWIFT ecosystem engagement

name: EIB/EBRD Funded Project or Guarantee
indicator: Company benefits from EIB, EBRD, or Nordic Investment Bank financing or guarantee
data_source: EIB project database, EBRD project database
search_method: Search EIB project database for company name; search EBRD project summaries
threshold: Named EIB or EBRD project with the company as beneficiary
anti_signal: No supranational development bank engagement

name: ESG / SFDR Classification Assessed
indicator: Company has formally assessed or obtained a Sustainable Finance Disclosure Regulation (SFDR) classification
data_source: Company website ESG/sustainability page, SFDR fund suitability disclosures
search_method: Search company website for 'SFDR', 'ESG', 'Article 8', 'Article 9'; check sustainability report
threshold: SFDR Article 8 or 9 classification assessed and disclosed
anti_signal: No ESG policy; no SFDR assessment despite EU LP base

name: B2B Enterprise Terms of Service Published
indicator: Company has publicly available enterprise terms of service governing B2B relationships (not consumer ToS)
search_method: Navigate to company website → Legal/Terms; check if ToS is enterprise-grade (SLA, data processing, liability limits)
threshold: Enterprise B2B ToS with SLA, DPA, and indemnification clauses
anti_signal: Only consumer ToS; or no ToS published

name: Named Partner in National Open Finance or Open Data Programme
indicator: Company is a named partner or participant in a national open finance programme (UK Open Banking, Finnish open finance, etc.)
data_source: Open Banking Limited (UK), national open finance initiative websites
search_method: Search '[company name] open banking partner' and '[company name] open finance'
threshold: Named participant in a national open finance programme with verifiable listing
anti_signal: No open finance programme engagement despite operating in payments or identity

name: SWIFT gpi or ISO 20022 Migration Enabler
indicator: Company's product is explicitly designed to facilitate SWIFT gpi adoption or ISO 20022 migration for banks
search_method: Search company website for 'SWIFT gpi', 'ISO 20022 migration'; search SWIFT publications for company name
threshold: Explicit ISO 20022 migration or SWIFT gpi enablement positioned as a core use case
anti_signal: No reference to ISO 20022 migration despite operating in cross-border payments

name: Company Offices in Major Financial Centres
indicator: Company has a physical office (not registered address only) in a major financial centre: Frankfurt, London, Stockholm, Zurich, Amsterdam, Copenhagen, Helsinki, Luxembourg
data_source: LinkedIn, Google Maps, company website contact page
search_method: Check company website 'About/Contact' page for office addresses; verify via Google Maps or LinkedIn employee locations
threshold: Physical office presence (with staff) in ≥1 major financial centre
anti_signal: Registered address only in a financial centre; all staff work remotely elsewhere

name: Named Participant in ECB Market Infrastructure Board Consultation
indicator: Company participated in an ECB Market Infrastructure Board or TARGET consultation
search_method: Search 'site:ecb.europa.eu [company name]'
threshold: Named participant in an ECB consultation or TARGET-related working group
anti_signal: No ECB engagement

name: No B2C Revenue Despite Long Operating History
indicator: Company has been operating for >3 years with no B2C revenue (pure B2B commitment signal)
search_method: Check company founding date vs. current revenue model; verify absence of B2C product across company history
threshold: ≥3 years operating with confirmed B2B-only revenue model
anti_signal: Company pivoted from B2C to B2B recently, or still has residual B2C product lines
